pages.quiz:
ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Attentive listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive listening.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Attentive listening.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive listening.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Attentive listening.

2. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the library
   B. Where is the library?
   C. Where is the Library
   D. where is the library

3. When practising Language School, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Language School.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Language School.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Language School.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language School.

4. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. goed
   B. goes
   C. went
   D. going

5. When practising Phonics, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonics.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Phonics.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Phonics.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Phonics.

6. When practising Connected text and fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text and fluency.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Connected text and fluency.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Connected text and fluency.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Connected text and fluency.

7. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.

8. When practising Language Welcome and, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Language Welcome and.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Language Welcome and.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Welcome and.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Language Welcome and.

9. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. One main idea with supporting sentences
   B. No full stops
   C. Only one word repeated
   D. Many unrelated topics with no link

10. When practising Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Handwriting.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Handwriting.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Handwriting.

11. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. happiness
   B. run
   C. blue
   D. quickly

12. When practising Pre-Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Pre-Writing.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Pre-Writing.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Pre-Writing.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre-Writing.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Connected text and fluency and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Pre-Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Handwriting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive listening.

2. B — Where is the library?

3. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language School.

4. C — went

5. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonics.

6. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text and fluency.

7. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.

8. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Welcome and.

9. A — One main idea with supporting sentences

10. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.

11. B — run

12. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre-Writing.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Connected text and fluency; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Comprehension; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Pre-Writing; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Handwriting; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
